2. **Social identity theory**: Wearing a suit and tie can signal to others that you're a professional, which can enhance your sense of identity and self-esteem. 4. **Physical appearance and body language**: Wearing a suit and tie can also affect your body language and nonverbal cues. You may stand up straighter, make more eye contact, and use more assertive gestures, which can all contribute to a more confident demeanor.
